title: XTB CEO Says Broker Was “a Bit Late” to the UK as Indonesia Trails Only Poland
summary:
XTB's chief executive said on Thursday that the Polish broker had probably arrived in the UK late. Omar Arnaout told a third-quarter results conference that competing there with established local firms would take very large sums, and that he would approach the market very cautiously.
In the same ans...
content:
2026-10-31T21:56:30.914+02:00

Saturday, 31/10/2026 | 19:56 GMT by Damian Chmiel

  • Omar Arnaout said competing with established British firms would take far bigger marketing budgets.
  • Its Asian unit added commodity CFDs in August, with a read on demand due within five weeks.

XTB's chief executive said on Thursday that the Polish broker had probably arrived in the UK late. Omar Arnaout told a third-quarter results conference that competing there with established local firms would take very large sums, and that he would approach the market very cautiously.

In the same answer, he said Indonesia now signs up more accounts each month than any XTB market except Poland. The conference followed a fourfold rise in XTB's third-quarter profit to PLN 213.7 million (about $54.4 million), reported on Wednesday.

Both countries were set up as tests for 2026. In January, Arnaout said this would be a test year for the UK, and in March he told FinanceMagnates.com that Indonesia, then a country with a question mark, had six months to prove itself.

London's trading industry is coming home!

A Late Start in Britain

The UK business is small next to the platforms it competes with. XTB's British unit more than doubled its revenue to £8.64 million (about $11.6 million) in 2025, while Trading 212 booked £277.6 million in the UK over the same year.

That puts XTB's British revenue at about 3% of its rival's, by FinanceMagnates.com's calculation.

"I think we were simply a bit late to this market," Arnaout said.

XTB launched a zero-fee stocks and shares ISA in December 2024 and added a cash ISA this year. It ran 11,767 ISA and cash ISA accounts at the end of September, up from 10,717 three months earlier, according to its quarterly reports.

The gain of about 1,050 accounts compares with the 152,000 customers AJ Bell added in the 12 months to September, as British platforms and CFD brokers compete for the same tax-free savers.

Where the Marketing Money Goes

XTB is planning next year's budgets now, and Arnaout said Germany would get a significant increase to compete with Trade Republic and Scalable Capital. He said in June that XTB would spend more on marketing in Germany than in Poland this year.

Germany has become one of XTB's most important markets by revenue, Arnaout said, though the company does not report the country separately.

In France, he said XTB should rank among the three or four most popular investing apps by the end of the year, while revenue there has yet to catch up with sign-ups.

Indonesia Moves Up the Sign-Up Table

Indonesia has moved the opposite way from the UK. XTB bought a 90% stake in the local broker Eagle Capital Futures in January 2024 and started with US stocks and exchange-traded funds, before winning approval to offer contracts for difference (CFDs) this summer.

Arnaout said earlier this year that the country produced XTB's fastest first 1,000 accounts but that deposits were low and the brand was unknown there. On Thursday he described the client intake as very large.

He said that "if my memory serves me correctly, only the Polish market signs up more accounts" each month than Indonesia.

XTB does not report accounts by country. Its Indonesian unit said in August that funded accounts rose 741.51% in the first half compared with the second half of 2025, a figure the company reports itself.

The unit also said in August that it had launched CFDs on gold, silver, palladium, oil and natural gas. Options followed in the third quarter, according to XTB's quarterly report.

Indonesia is also one of the markets in the advertising campaign with Zlatan Ibrahimovic and Tyson Fury that started on October 1. Arnaout said XTB stepped up marketing for the CFDs this week and should know within four to five weeks how much demand they draw.

Other Foreign Brokers Moved In Too

XTB is one of several foreign brokers that bought or licensed their way into Indonesia's regulated futures market since 2024.

Plus500 took over Global Intra Berjangka, a local broker that had stopped taking new clients, as FinanceMagnates.com reported last December, and AIMS opened a Jakarta office in May under a license from the Commodity Futures Trading Regulatory Agency (Bappebti).

The regulated customer base those brokers compete for runs to tens of thousands. Bappebti rated 67 active futures brokers in the second quarter, and the market had 70,676 active retail customers in November 2024, up 53.93% from a year earlier, FM Intelligence data show.

Indonesia drew 5.5 million organic visits to retail FX and CFD broker websites in the third quarter, 0.9% fewer than in the second, FM Intelligence's heat map shows.

Traffic across the Asia-Pacific region dropped 33% over the same period.

title: Bitcoin Whitepaper Turns 18: How Satoshi’s 9-Page Vision Reshaped Global Finance
summary:
Key Takeaways: On October 31, 2008, the Bitcoin whitepaper was published by Satoshi Nakamoto, which outlines a peer-to-peer electronic cash system, without the need for banks. Eighteen years later, Bitcoin
The post Bitcoin Whitepaper Turns 18: How Satoshi’s 9-Page Vision Reshaped Global Finance appe...
content:
Key Takeaways:

  • On October 31, 2008, the Bitcoin whitepaper was published by Satoshi Nakamoto, which outlines a peer-to-peer electronic cash system, without the need for banks.
  • Eighteen years later, Bitcoin developed from a novel monetary system to an asset owned by public organizations, investment funds, and governments.
  • Bitcoin Archive celebrated the occasion on its X page, restating the bold conclusion that the crypto industry began.

Bitcoin’s whitepaper was created on October 31st, 2008, marking 18 years in digital asset history. The initial allotment of nine pages of documents to send the funds without any process of money brokering has now become a worldwide network of trillions of dollars’ worth.

  • Satoshi Nakamoto Introduced a Different Way to Move Money
  • Bitcoin Has Moved Beyond Its Early Cypherpunk Community
    • The 18th Anniversary Brings Attention Back to Satoshi’s Idea

Satoshi Nakamoto Introduced a Different Way to Move Money

On October 31, 2008, an individual or group using the name Satoshi Nakamoto published Bitcoin: A Peer-to-Peer Electronic Cash System on a cryptography mailing list.

One major problem with online payments was that too often, financial institutions had to confirm the transfers of funds and avoid double spending. Satoshi envisioned a new peer-to-peer system that did not require central control to function: When people make an exchange, the transaction is verified using cryptographic proof, with a shared and publicly visible record containing the transactions.

This design was a distributed ledger plus proof-of-work. The miners confirm transactions, create new blocks, and miners are rewarded with transactions whenever the network follows the longest chain with largest proof-of-work.

On January 3, 2009, the Bitcoin network came into operation by mining the first block. This protocol later comes to be associated with a maximum supply of 21 million BTC and the assets are issued at a predictable time frame.

Read More: Michael Saylor Teases More Bitcoin After Strategy’s $69.45B Reserve Hits 848,250 BTC

Bitcoin Has Moved Beyond Its Early Cypherpunk Community

The network has since expanded well beyond the realm of cryptography, where the paper first appeared. U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs launched in January 2024, providing another channel for traditional investors to buy Bitcoin without owning cryptocurrency wallets.

Public companies are also including Bitcoin on their balance sheets. Some other examples include strategy being the largest publicly listed corporate holder and the U.S. government creating a Strategic Bitcoin Reserve in March 2025 using seized Bitcoins.

This represents a significant shift from Bitcoin’s early years, when every Bitcoin was dominated by technology enthusiasts and early adopters.

The 18th Anniversary Brings Attention Back to Satoshi’s Idea

Bitcoin Archive recently marked the occasion on X with a message celebrating 18 years of Bitcoin and thanking Satoshi Nakamoto. Another aspect of the network’s creation was also touched on in the post, the historic moment.

18 years of Bitcoin.

Thank you, Satoshi — what an incredible journey. https://t.co/DhYNB3SZ9y

— Bitcoin Archive (@BitcoinArchive) October 31, 2026

However, Bitcoin’s original concept has stayed true to its nature, allowing users to make transactions on a public network without a bank or payment company approving it.

Satoshi’s identity remains unknown, and the white paper’s publication began a project that would eventually influence thousands of other digital assets and blockchain networks.

title: Binance says 90% of stolen assets replenished, targets Sunday withdrawals
summary: Less-liquid tokens make up the remaining shortfall as Binance continues buying replacement assets through market and over-the-counter trades.
content:
Binance said Saturday it had replenished 90% of the assets stolen in its $6.3 billion hack, up from 80% a day earlier, and remained on track to resume withdrawals Sunday.

The exchange is using a combination of its corporate treasury, a partial deployment of its Secure Asset Fund for Users (SAFU) and a portion of its futures insurance fund, a spokesperson told Cointelegraph.

“Binance will absorb the financial impact of the stolen funds, not users,” the spokesperson said, adding that the insurance fund would remain above required risk management levels.

The update follows Thursday’s theft, the largest cryptocurrency hack on record, which TRM Labs has since attributed to North Korea’s TraderTraitor hacker group.

Following the hack, Binance said Friday it had set aside $6.34 billion to cover losses, including $5 billion in the affected cryptocurrencies. Industry partners like Tether and Circle froze about $3 billion in affected assets after the hack, but those funds are separate from Binance’s replacement of stolen tokens.

Still, CertiK told Cointelegraph on Friday that it needed more information to verify Binance’s claimed $5 billion in replacement cryptocurrencies. Binance has since published a new reserves snapshot, but says the full cryptographic proof is still being generated. “The full zero-knowledge proof takes approximately 40 to 50 hours to generate due to the computational workload,” the exchange’s update reads.

Binance said in its update on X that customer balances in Bitcoin (BTC), Ether (ETH) and eight other assets were fully backed. The remaining shortfall consists of less liquid tokens that it continues to buy through market and over-the-counter transactions, the update reads.

The spokesperson’s statement did not specify how much each funding source contributed or disclose the insurance fund’s minimum required balance. It also did not quantify how much stolen crypto had been recovered.

Read Cointelegraph’s full coverage of the Binance hack here.

title: Pudgy Penguins (PENGU) Price Prediction: Can Bulls Break $0.011 Resistance and Trigger a Major Rally?
summary: Pudgy Penguins (PENGU) is facing another important test as traders monitor whether buyers can regain control after a prolonged decline.
content:
Skip to content
Assets: PENGU

Pudgy Penguins (PENGU) is facing another important test as traders monitor whether buyers can regain control after a prolonged decline.

PENGU recently traded near $0.0073, with technical analysts identifying $0.011 as a critical resistance level that has repeatedly limited recovery attempts.

Despite occasional rebounds, PENGU remains under pressure across several timeframes. Traders are watching nearby support around $0.0070 and $0.0068, while a deeper historical support zone near $0.0055 could become important if selling resumes. The latest chart analysis suggests that a sustained move above resistance could improve the outlook, although current indicators do not yet confirm a broader bullish reversal.

PENGU Price Faces Key Resistance Near $0.011

Crypto trader @MstrTranquility recently highlighted PENGU’s daily chart, identifying approximately $0.011 as a persistent resistance zone. According to the analyst’s technical assessment, the token has faced repeated rejections around this level over several months.

The chart highlights resistance near $0.011 and support around $0.0055, with a potential sharp rally if resistance is breached. Source: @MstrTranquility via X

The chart also identifies approximately $0.0055 as an important support area, where buyers have previously stepped in to defend the price. The distance between these two levels outlines a broad trading range that could determine PENGU’s next significant move.

A decisive breakout above $0.011 would indicate that buyers are overcoming a resistance zone that has repeatedly restricted upward momentum. However, a brief move above the level would not necessarily establish a lasting trend reversal. Sustained trading above resistance, supported by stronger volume, would provide more convincing evidence of improving demand.

Another trader, @alekstraderx, shared a 12-hour Bybit perpetual chart showing additional support and resistance confluence zones. The analysis places a nearby support area around $0.0068, with overhead resistance extending toward $0.0106.

These levels offer a more detailed view of PENGU’s shorter-term trading structure. The $0.0068 region is particularly relevant because it sits below the psychological $0.0070 threshold. A successful defense could help stabilize the token, while a sustained breakdown may expose it to additional selling pressure.

PENGU Technical Indicators Maintain a Bearish Bias

TradingView’s technical summary points to a difficult market structure for PENGU despite its occasional intraday recoveries. At the time of the supplied analysis, the token was trading around $0.00735, up approximately 0.88% over 24 hours.

However, the broader performance remained negative. PENGU had declined approximately 4.82% over seven days and 22.95% over the previous month. Its market capitalization stood near $464 million, reflecting the impact of the recent correction.

The 12-hour Bybit perpetual chart highlights key PENGU support near $0.0068 and resistance up to $0.0106 amid a prevailing downtrend. Source: @alekstraderx via X

Moving averages remain an important obstacle for a sustained recovery. Several short- and long-term simple moving averages (SMA) and exponential moving averages (EMA) were positioned above the spot price in the supplied technical assessment. This configuration suggests that previous support levels have turned into potential resistance zones.

The Relative Strength Index (RSI) also provides limited evidence of an immediate reversal. Rather than showing an extreme oversold reading that might indicate an exhausted sell-off, the indicator remains closer to neutral or weaker momentum territory.

TradingView’s broader technical assessment therefore favors caution. A modest daily recovery does not necessarily mean that the prevailing downtrend has ended. Buyers would need to reclaim important moving averages and establish higher price lows before the market structure could be considered more constructive.

$0.0083 and $0.0070 Define the Immediate PENGU Price Outlook

In the shorter term, approximately $0.00829 represents an important overhead resistance level in the supplied TradingView analysis. Reclaiming this area could help PENGU move away from its immediate bearish structure and bring higher resistance zones into focus.

A sustained move above $0.0083 would provide an early indication that buying pressure is improving. However, the token would still need to overcome the broader resistance around $0.0106 to $0.011 before a stronger bullish scenario could develop.

Pudgy Penguins (PENGU) price chart. Source: Brave New Coin

On the downside, $0.0070 represents an immediate psychological support level. Maintaining this area could allow the token to consolidate and attract buyers following its recent correction.

The nearby $0.0068 zone identified in the 12-hour Bybit chart provides another level to monitor. If PENGU loses both $0.0070 and $0.0068, selling pressure could increase as traders reassess the likelihood of a recovery.

A deeper support area near $0.0037 also appears in the TradingView assessment. This level represents a more distant downside reference rather than an immediate target. A move toward it would require a substantial deterioration in the current price structure.

Pudgy Penguins’ NFT Brand Provides Broader Market Context

PENGU is associated with the Pudgy Penguins ecosystem, which began as an Ethereum-based NFT collection of 8,888 individual penguin characters in 2021. The project subsequently expanded beyond digital collectibles into physical merchandise, including plush toys distributed through major retail channels.

This expansion has helped establish Pudgy Penguins as a consumer-facing Web3 brand rather than an NFT project focused exclusively on digital trading. Its physical products have also introduced the brand to audiences who may not actively participate in cryptocurrency markets.

The PENGU token has a maximum supply of approximately 88.89 billion tokens. Despite the brand’s broader commercial presence, the token remains exposed to cryptocurrency market volatility, speculative trading activity, and changing investor sentiment.

PENGU also trades substantially below its 2024 all-time high, which was approximately $0.068 according to the market data. Its current price near $0.0073 represents a significant decline from that historical peak.

The distinction between brand expansion and token performance remains important. Commercial visibility does not automatically translate into sustained demand for the associated cryptocurrency. Market participants will continue to assess token liquidity, trading activity, and broader market conditions when evaluating PENGU’s valuation.

Can PENGU Break $0.011 and Trigger a Major Rally?

The $0.011 resistance zone remains the central level in the bullish scenario for Pudgy Penguins. A successful breakout could signal a shift in market sentiment, particularly if it coincides with increasing trading volume and improving momentum indicators.

Before reaching that level, however, PENGU must overcome intermediate resistance around $0.0083 and the broader $0.0106 area. These price zones could attract sellers and limit recovery attempts. Buyers would need to establish sustained support above each threshold to strengthen the case for further upside.

The bearish scenario remains relevant if the token fails to hold its nearby support levels. A breakdown below $0.0068 could weaken the short-term structure, while a deeper decline toward $0.0055 would bring the historical support zone highlighted by @MstrTranquility back into focus.

For now, PENGU’s technical outlook remains cautious. Its expanding consumer brand offers a broader ecosystem narrative, but the price chart continues to reflect selling pressure. A confirmed breakout above $0.011, rather than an isolated upward move, would provide stronger evidence that bulls are regaining control.

Key Takeaways: The Bank of England is seeking input on tokenized collateral for central clearing. All tokenizable assets must be equally liquid and equally risky in terms of risk. The
The post Bank of England Opens Tokenized Collateral Door With 2027 Deadline for UK Clearing appeared first on Crypto...
content:
Key Takeaways:

  • The Bank of England is seeking input on tokenized collateral for central clearing.
  • All tokenizable assets must be equally liquid and equally risky in terms of risk.
  • The consultation will be open until Feb. 12, 2027.

The Bank of England comes closer and closer to introducing tokenized assets into the mainstream of the UK market infrastructure.

The central bank has launched a consultation outlining how central counterparties, or CCPs, could accept tokenized versions of eligible collateral without creating a separate regulatory regime for blockchain-based assets.

  • Bank of England Opens the Door to Tokenized Collateral
  • Same Risk, Same Regulatory Outcome
    • Stablecoins Could Enter the Conversation Later
    • UK Pushes Tokenization Deeper Into Wholesale Finance

Bank of England Opens the Door to Tokenized Collateral

The proposal concentrates on assets that are or could be already collaterized according to the UK’s CCP.

The Bank says tokenization by itself won’t bar an asset from being accepted. What’s important is whether the collateral remains easily transferable and saleable, has little credit risk and market risk, and can still be valued.

The Bank has reported that tokenization of collateral can facilitate trades of assets across markets and jurisdictions, particularly in meeting margin calls. Faster collateral movement could also reduce operational friction in clearing and support wider adoption of digital market infrastructure.

Read More: Blockchain.com and NYSE Target 24/7 Tokenized Stocks for 44 Million Crypto Accounts

Same Risk, Same Regulatory Outcome

The Bank is sticking to a simple rule: tokenized collateral should achieve the same regulatory result as traditional collateral. That means CCPs would need to show that digital representations of assets remain accessible and transferable even during stressed market conditions.

The regulator additionally urges firms to look at the risk associated with technology, custody arrangements and reliance on third-party infrastructure. For instance, tokenized security relying on a bridge that links blockchain records to other asset locations would require knowledge of the consequences of the bridge being compromised.

Stablecoins Could Enter the Conversation Later

The consultation doesn’t instantly add to the list of collaterals that are eligible. It primarily concentrates on the tokenisation of assets currently allowed under the existing regulations, such as cash, financial instruments, bank guarantees and gold, provided they meet established criteria.

But also the Bank´s position is seeking input from industry on a wider array of assets that may qualify in the future. That conversation also covers tokenized money market fund shares, tokenized gold, and stablecoins, so it’s applicable to the entire crypto ecosystem.

Some digital assets could eventually comply with existing collateral standards, the Bank said, and advised firms contemplating digital assets to reach out to supervisors early on.

UK Pushes Tokenization Deeper Into Wholesale Finance

The consultation is part of a wider consultation by the Bank of England, Financial Conduct Authority and HM Treasury in the UK. Their mission is to establish a more straightforward rule for tokenized securities and settlement in the digital medium, while fostering financial stability.

It will help foster responsible tokenization while maintaining the resilience of financial market infrastructure, said Deputy Governor for Financial Stability, Sarah Breeden. The consultation will continue through Feb. 12, 2027, and the Bank takes into account industry comments to decide its supervisory strategy.

title: Jupiter Lend Halts Withdrawals Amid $6.3B Binance Hack Fears Despite Zero Exposure
summary:
Key Takeaways: Following the liquidity crisis due to market turmoil after Binance’s security breach of $6.3 billion, Jupiter Lend has temporarily shut down withdrawals. The protocol claims it never had
The post Jupiter Lend Halts Withdrawals Amid $6.3B Binance Hack Fears Despite Zero Exposure appear...
content:
Key Takeaways:

  • Following the liquidity crisis due to market turmoil after Binance’s security breach of $6.3 billion, Jupiter Lend has temporarily shut down withdrawals.
  • The protocol claims it never had any exposure to Binance, there have been no funds on the exchange, no loss of funds to report.
  • Withdrawals are likely to begin once loans are repaid and new supplies are available.

Uncertainty about the security issue on Binance has been seeping into the crypto sector and dragging down Jupiter Lend. According to the Solana lending platform, its infrastructure is live, but users will have to wait for the withdrawal of liquidity.

Read More: Binance Says $6.3B Hit in Security Breach, $3B Frozen After DevOps Laptop Compromise

  • Jupiter Lend Faces Liquidity Crunch
  • Why Are Withdrawals Being Delayed?
    • USDC Withdrawable Balance Raises Concerns

Jupiter Lend Faces Liquidity Crunch

On October 30, Jupiter addressed withdrawal delays through its official X account, explaining that broader market conditions had created a liquidity shortage across its lending pools.

Due to broader market conditions, there is currently a liquidity crunch impacting withdrawals.

Market conditions will cause users to deposit or repay their loans. As they do so, withdrawals will be able to process again.

This is normal and expected during events like today’s. Liquidity will soon be available again.

The protocol is functioning as expected and all funds are safe.

— Jupiter Earn (@jupiter_earn) October 30, 2026

Withdrawals would be resumed as market players deposit their assets or repay their loans, the protocol said. It said the situation was normal at all times of significant market volatility and all funds belonging to users are safe.

The announcement came amid increasing security fears surrounding Binance and market actions by the broader crypto sector. Jupiter had earlier said that it was keeping an eye on development and had never had any direct exposure to Binance.

Users asked how there could be any contradiction between the earlier reassurance and the delays in withdrawal, to which Jupiter responded that both the things were correct.

It noted that Binance couldn’t raise any money and the protocol didn’t lose any. The withdrawal pressure is not directly related to the exchange incident, the team said and instead is an indicator of reactions from the wider market.

Read More: Binance $5.5B Hack Exposed: 50 EIP-7702 Nonces Opened One Hot Wallet in Minutes

Why Are Withdrawals Being Delayed?

Jupiter Lend gifts work by means of lending pools where a deposited good can be borrowed by items like Borrow and Multiply. This is because not all deposits will be available immediately as some assets may be used to make loans on the go.

Liquidity may not keep up with the demand for it in periods of heavy withdrawal demand. The repayment of borrowers and fresh money for deposits are therefore significant in restoring withdrawal capacity.

USDC Withdrawable Balance Raises Concerns

Jupiter’s API data aptly pointed to the magnitude of the liquidity situation. Around 418.5 million USDCs in Earn deposit claims, with accrued interest, were visible at 7.14 a.m. ET, whereas 3.35 USDCs were immediately available to withdraw.

This difference reflects the amount of the claims of depositors serviceable by the bank at a given time versus the liquid funds held by the bank. That is not, however, a finding of loan impairment nor a determination that depositors have been losing money on the underlying loans.

In addition to the above, Jupiter documents further withdrawals based on available amounts and permission to withdraw. Users might have to make smaller withdrawals or wait for returns of liquidity.

The withdrawal scenario comes amidst worries over Binance’s security breach, estimated to cause around $6.3 billion damage to Binance.

title: Tether Q3 Profit Hits $1.5B While USDT Reserve Buffer Nearly Doubles to $8B
summary:
Key Takeaways: In Q3, Tether achieved an operating profit of $1.5 billion. Reserve assets rose to almost $8 billion. U.S. Treasury exposure reached $132.4 billion. Tether also added another $1.5
The post Tether Q3 Profit Hits $1.5B While USDT Reserve Buffer Nearly Doubles to $8B appeared first on Cr...
content:
Key Takeaways:

  • In Q3, Tether achieved an operating profit of $1.5 billion.
  • Reserve assets rose to almost $8 billion.
  • U.S. Treasury exposure reached $132.4 billion.

Tether also added another $1.5 billion in operating profits during the quarter, and considerably boosted the buffer for USDT. As of the end of September, the stablecoin issuer’s most recent BDO attestation reports $191.5 billion in assets against $183.5 billion in liabilities within total reserves.

Read More: Tether Backs Peso to Expand USDT Payments Across 4 Major Latin American Markets

  • Tether Reserve Buffer Jumps $3.8B in One Quarter
  • Treasury Holdings Drive Tether’s Earnings
    • Nine-Month Operating Profit Reaches $4.5B
    • USDT Still Controls More Than 60% of Stablecoins

Tether Reserve Buffer Jumps $3.8B in One Quarter

Tether’s surpluses surged from $4.1 billion at the end of June to $7.95 billion.

The increase added roughly $3.8 billion to the company’s reserve surplus in a single quarter. Total assets increased to $191.45 billion with total liabilities reaching $183.50 billion, with a majority of the liabilities held by digital tokens issued being about $183.47 billion.

USDT issuance demonstrated overall strength at approximately $184 billion despite fluctuations in market sentiment for cryptocurrencies during the first nine months of 2026.

Treasury Holdings Drive Tether’s Earnings

Tether said U.S. Treasury bills and reverse re-purchase agreements continued to be the primary sources of operating income. As of September 30 government debt represented the primary asset of the reserve portfolio exceeding $132.4 billion via direct and indirect holdings of Treasury bills.

That asset allocation will give them significant short-term liquidity, in short-term, liquid bonds, that can support redeeming when the market is in a state of stress.

Nine-Month Operating Profit Reaches $4.5B

Tether generated $4.5 billion in net operating profit during the first three quarters of 2026.

Q3’s operating profit was reported at $1.5 billion, on par with in Q2. Tether said it had $4.11 billion in reserve for the second quarter, and that number grew dramatically for Q3.

The higher surplus provides Tether with more liquidity to redeem tokens and cover the cost of maintaining infrastructure during tough market conditions, CEO Paolo Ardoino wrote.

The statistics were revealed after Tether underwent its first full independent financial statement audit in August. KPMG U.S. gave an unqualified opinion for the company’s 2025 financial statements.

Read More: Tether Clears First-Ever KPMG Audit, Revealing a $6.8B Cushion for Crypto Markets

USDT Still Controls More Than 60% of Stablecoins

Despite the USDT circulating market capitalization dropping below the $184 billion USDT issuance figure reported in the quarter-end statement, USDT remains the largest dollar-backed token.

DefiLlama revealed that USDT netted a market capitalization of approximately USD 180 billion on 30 October, with the overall market of stablecoins valued at nearly USD 297 billion. This means the USDT is around 60.6% dominant.

The gap indicates the difference between Tether’s September 30 reporting date and the current market data at a point in time circulating.

As excess reserves near $8 billion and the portfolio is heavily weighted with Bitcoin securities, Tether will go into 2026’s 4th quarter with a considerably healthier financial cushion to support the crypto market’s most prominent stable coin.

title: Hoskinson Flags ‘Dangerous’ EIP-7702 Code After Binance’s $6.3B Crypto Breach
summary:
Key Takeaways: Hoskinson issued a warning about “seriously dangerous code” that is associated with the Binance hack. Based on an engineering researcher’s estimate, 50 EIP-7702 authorizations were directed at Binance
The post Hoskinson Flags ‘Dangerous’ EIP-7702 Code After Binance’s $6.3B Crypto Brea...
content:
Key Takeaways:

  • Hoskinson issued a warning about “seriously dangerous code” that is associated with the Binance hack.
  • Based on an engineering researcher’s estimate, 50 EIP-7702 authorizations were directed at Binance 14.
  • Even for EIP-7702, the account in question must still be properly cryptographically authorized.

Cardano’s founder Charles Hoskinson has echoed worries regarding Ethereum’s EIP-7702, following the investigators’ new allegation that the delegation function could be responsible for part of the massive Binance security breach.

The exchange has lost about $6.3 billion worth of crypto, based on recent reporting, but inquiries into the exact how the attackers obtained signing access continues.

  • Hoskinson Sounds Alarm Over Binance Sweeper Code
  • $823M USDC Vault Was Allegedly Within Reach
    • EIP-7702 Could Speed Execution, but It Cannot Forge Permission
    • Ethereum Specification Already Warns of Delegation Risk

Hoskinson Sounds Alarm Over Binance Sweeper Code

Hoskinson shared a technical breakdown from researcher CyberSatoshi with a blunt warning: “Careful, there is some seriously dangerous code out there.”

Careful, there is some seriously dangerous code out there. https://t.co/w7wM1nn0Lz

— Charles Hoskinson (@IOHK_Charles) October 30, 2026

The Binance wallet known as “Binance 14” was the target of a custom sweeper contract, the analysis states. When guiding the change of the wallet’s own ETH, it allegedly left precisely one ETH behind, which possibly meant that automated transaction systems continued to function as assets were taken away.

The contract also included a design that would continue to execute tokens even if their individual transfers were attempted to be failed.

Read More: Binance $5.5B Hack Exposed: 50 EIP-7702 Nonces Opened One Hot Wallet in Minutes

$823M USDC Vault Was Allegedly Within Reach

CyberSatoshi also stated that the wallet’s compromised execution function enabled it to act on an external vault that held some $823 million in USDC.

Reading the reconstructed bytecode of the Binance EIP-7702 sweeper (`0x63e8…6fae`) is wild.

This wasn’t a generic drainer. It was custom-engineered for Binance 14’s architecture:

– Leaves exactly 1 ether behind (`bal – 1 ether`) when sweeping ETH so Binance’s automated hot wallet queue wouldn’t error on gas and trip alarms.
– Uses raw `staticcall` + `continue` loops with custom error codes (`SweepItemFailed`) so one bricked or blacklisted ERC-20 wouldn’t revert the $6B batch.
– Includes a custom `callExecute` function to impersonate Binance 14 as controller of an external vault holding $823M in USDC.

They leave a comment: “robberies could be prevented if getaway cars were slower.”

You can’t fully blame EIP-7702, but it sped up the attack. Without 7702, draining 64 tokens plus an external $823M vault from a live exchange hot wallet meant fighting moving nonces across 70+ transactions. Defense systems would’ve killed it after tx #3.

With 7702, Lazarus sprayed 50 consecutive nonces in one type-4 payload, turned an EOA into a custom proxy, and atomically swept billions in a single block.

Ethereum core devs built the ultimate getaway car. Surgical state-sponsored engineering.

This could be etched onchain:
`if (bal > 1 ether) { https://t.co/ou2j9VqGvv{value: bal – 1 ether}(“”); }`

— CyberSatoshi 𓆙 (@XBToshi) October 30, 2026

Binance 14 supposedly knew more about that vault and delegated code can act on the basis of that wallet’s already granted just one activity.

They are presented based on researcher’s reconstruction and may not be reliable as Binance has confirmed. However, independent charges have reported seeing an EIP-7702 transaction that has 50 authorizations to be signed by Binance 14.

EIP-7702 Could Speed Execution, but It Cannot Forge Permission

The difference makes a lot of difference. EIP-7702 enables an EO A (Ethernet globally owned account) to delegate execution to the code of a smart contract. An authorization has a chain ID, an address of a delegate and a nonce and a signature. Ethereum checks out the signature prior to delegation.

This will prevent attackers from easily hijacking an arbitrary Binance wallet and loading malicious code on it. Cyber Satoshi’s team also noted that the criminal would have to obtain the private keys or have access to Binance’s signing systems which would be strong enough.

Delegated code, however, when granted access, can be made much more powerful on execution, as the code is executed within the context of the account.

Read More: Binance Says $6.3B Hit in Security Breach, $3B Frozen After DevOps Laptop Compromise

Ethereum Specification Already Warns of Delegation Risk

EIP-7702, officially written documentation of Ethereum, has a strong disclaimer that delegated code is available to full access of the account and should be carefully audited. The specification also relates to the fact that if the contracts of the delegates are not carefully crafted, the malicious party can essentially control the signer’s EOA with very few limitations.

The Binance incident of course gives rise to two distinct security concerns: firstly, how the attackers were able to acquire a valid signing key, and secondly, how it affected the speed and volume of asset transfers after the key was acquired.

Hoskinson’s message stresses the second point and the others are also the crux of uncovering the cause of the breach.

title: Binance $6.3B Hack Triggers FBI Probe While $3B in Stolen Crypto Gets Frozen
summary:
Key Takeaways: Binance’s hot wallets were hacked for approximately $6.3 billion. Already, about $3 billion of assets have been seized. Binance allocated over $6.34 billion of reserves for user losses.
The post Binance $6.3B Hack Triggers FBI Probe While $3B in Stolen Crypto Gets Frozen appeared firs...
content:
Key Takeaways:

  • Binance’s hot wallets were hacked for approximately $6.3 billion.
  • Already, about $3 billion of assets have been seized.
  • Binance allocated over $6.34 billion of reserves for user losses.

U.S. law enforcement has also been involved in the response to Binance’s massive crypto hack, working with the exchange and industry partners to track the sources of stolen funds. Binance says users will not absorb the losses and has committed company resources and its SAFU fund to make affected balances whole.

  • FBI Joins Hunt After Binance Loses $6.3 Billion
  • Nearly Half the Stolen Assets Are Already Frozen
    • Binance Sets Aside $6.34B to Protect Users
    • Withdrawals and Proof of Reserves Take Center Stage

FBI Joins Hunt After Binance Loses $6.3 Billion

According to Binance, the hack caused about $6.3 billion worth of withdrawals from Binance hot wallets on Oct. 29. The FBI told Reuters it’s collaborating with both public and private partners to determine the extent of the situation and carry out investigative measures. According to Bloomberg separately Thursday, U.S. Secret Service investigators are also helping in the recovery.

Binance initially blamed the attack on a hacked DevOps engineer’s laptop but stated that they had found more points of attack. There is no evidence of the private keys in wallets being leaked, the company said.

Read More: Binance Says $6.3B Hit in Security Breach, $3B Frozen After DevOps Laptop Compromise

Nearly Half the Stolen Assets Are Already Frozen

Binance says approximately $3 billion of the affected assets has been frozen onchain through cooperation with token issuers, exchanges, blockchain intelligence firms and law enforcement. That leaves a lot of remaining victims not yet found and going unrecovered.

According to Reuters, the stablecoin issuers managed to freeze some of the stolen money, while assets like Bitcoin and Ether are less easily held due to the absence of centralized issuers that allow the assets to be frozen.

Binance Sets Aside $6.34B to Protect Users

The incident is covered by over $6.34 billion of Binance’s company funds.

Of this total, roughly $5 billion is already locked in stolen tokens, which include BTC, ETH, BNB, USD, USDT, holding nickname assets. The exchange claims it is buying up the balance using market and OTC channels to interface with users.

According to Binance, around 80% of the value of those impacted is already covered by the $5 billion standing of reserves.

https://t.co/eeLPCUjIxR

— Binance (@binance) October 30, 2026

The company stressed that the figures do not include assets that have already been frozen or otherwise protected, which remain subject to recovery and verification.

Withdrawals and Proof of Reserves Take Center Stage

The withdrawal process was temporarily paused, as Binance implements further security testing and remediation measures.

The exchange said it’s going to reopen withdrawals in steps as those checks are finished. It also plans to release a revamped PoR to allow users to check platform balances against customer balances.

An in-depth technical forensic analysis will also be undertaken after investigators determine the attack sequence.

The attack is now the biggest crypto-theft by value that has ever occurred on an exchange, calling for centralized exchanges to reinforce their transaction-signing infrastructure, hot wallet controls and real-time monitoring.

title: Weekly Recap: FTMO Founders Discuss Futures Expansion; Plus500 Pushes Guidance Higher
summary:
The retail trading industry saw developments across
proprietary trading, listed derivatives and broker performance this week.
FTMO’s founders discussed the firm’s futures launch, its acquisition of OANDA
and its ambitions to build a larger trading group. Meanwhile, Plus500 raised
its full-year outlo...
content:
The retail trading industry saw developments across proprietary trading, listed derivatives and broker performance this week. FTMO’s founders discussed the firm’s futures launch, its acquisition of OANDA and its ambitions to build a larger trading group. Meanwhile, Plus500 raised its full-year outlook, and NinjaTrader extended its futures platform into the UK.

London's trading industry is coming home!

Quarterly results also highlighted contrasting trends among brokers. CFI reported record trading volumes, while XTB’s profit rose sharply despite lower client trading activity. XTB’s client assets also showed a growing preference for stocks and exchange-traded funds, even as contracts for difference continued to generate most of its trading income.

Elsewhere, institutional trading technology and customer acquisition strategies remained in focus, with analysis examining execution infrastructure and the challenges of reaching forex traders across markets in the Commonwealth of Independent States.

FTMO’s Futures Launch Follows a Decade of Growth and the OANDA Deal

FTMO co-founders Otakar Šuffner and Marek Vašíček discussed the firm’s move into futures trading, its acquisition of OANDA and the challenges facing proprietary trading firms. Founded in 2015, FTMO initially focused on CFDs because it lacked the capital and experience to enter futures.

The company launched its futures offering recently, responding to customer demand and a market where futures evaluations can cost less than comparable CFD and forex challenges. The founders said combining FTMO’s business with OANDA’s established reputation could help distinguish the group from newer firms.

FTMO Futures is officially LIVE. 🏆 The gold standard of prop trading, now powered for the exchange via Tradovate, NinjaTrader, and TradingView. No compromises. Just raw execution and total transparency. Explore FTMO Futures today 🙌🏻 https://t.co/g8HztyeUu4 https://t.co/WMDSy8DcRX

— FTMO.com (@FTMO_com) August 31, 2026

They also discussed regulatory uncertainty, abusive trading groups targeting evaluation systems and the possibility of a future initial public offering.

Plus500 Raises Its 2026 Outlook After Revenue Growth

Plus500 expects full-year 2026 revenue and EBITDA to exceed market expectations, reversing its guidance from July, when it forecast results in line with consensus. Third-quarter revenue rose 11% year on year to $203.2 million, while EBITDA increased 7% to $88.4 million.

Revenue for the first nine months reached $666.1 million, up 11%. New customers rose 27% to 28,747 in the quarter, active customers increased 4% to 119,528 and average revenue per user reached $1,700. Customer deposits hit a quarterly record of $1.9 billion. The company also reported growth in customer trading income, while interest income fell amid lower global interest rates.

NinjaTrader Brings Its Retail Futures Platform to the UK

NinjaTrader has launched its retail futures trading platform in the UK, extending a European rollout that already covers Germany, France, Italy, Spain and the Netherlands. UK customers can access futures on US equity indices, energy, metals and foreign exchange through CME and Eurex markets.

The platform includes proprietary charting tools, algorithmic trading capabilities and native TradingView integration. NinjaTrader said UK traders had sought direct market access, transparent pricing and execution , and a platform designed specifically for futures.

The launch comes as European brokers explore listed products amid regulatory pressure on CFDs, more experienced retail traders and competition from US firms specialising in futures and options.

CFI Reports Record Quarterly Trading Volume of $3.45 Trillion

CFI Financial Group reported third-quarter notional trading volume of $3.45 trillion, a record for the Dubai-based broker and an increase of about 123% year on year. The figure was 14% higher than in the second quarter. Trading volume for the first nine months reached $8.8 trillion, roughly double the same period last year and already above CFI’s full-year 2025 total of $6.4 trillion.

The company has reported higher volumes in each quarter of 2026, rising from $2.3 trillion in the first quarter to $3.03 trillion in the second. The growth came as the broader broker market tracked by Finance Magnates Intelligence contracted in the second quarter.

XTB’s Quarterly Profit Rises Fourfold Despite Lower Client Trading

XTB reported preliminary third-quarter net profit of PLN 213.7 million, around $54 million, four times the result a year earlier and 6.4% above the average analyst forecast. The figure was nevertheless less than half the PLN 492.2 million recorded in the second quarter. Revenue rose 65.9% year on year to PLN 623.3 million, even as clients traded 18.3% fewer CFD lots.

Revenue per lot nearly doubled to PLN 301 from PLN 152 a year earlier. Commodity CFDs generated 70.8% of the broker’s gross result on financial instruments. The year-on-year comparison reflected a weaker third quarter in 2025, when low market volatility weighed on revenue and profit.

Stocks Dominate XTB Client Assets, While CFDs Drive Trading Income

XTB clients held PLN 56.2 billion, about $14.2 billion, with the broker at the end of September, up by two-thirds since the start of the year. Stocks and exchange-traded funds accounted for 86% of those assets, while open CFD positions represented 1.3%.

However, CFDs continued to generate most of the broker’s trading income, contributing 90.5% of its gross result on financial instruments in the third quarter, based on Finance Magnates’ calculation from XTB’s preliminary report.

That share was down from 96% in the first half. Chief executive Omar Arnaout has said he wants to reduce the contribution from CFDs to around 70%, as investment products attract more clients.

Institutional Traders Put Execution Infrastructure Ahead of Spreads

Trading technology and execution quality are becoming key differentiators for brokers serving institutional clients, according to an analysis of the market. Tight spreads and deep liquidity remain important, but institutions also need pricing aggregation, low latency, smart order routing, automated hedging, reliable market data and systems that can withstand market stress.

They increasingly expect APIs and integration with order management, execution management and transaction cost analysis tools. Paul Golden highlights the difficulty of assessing execution costs for index CFDs, whose prices can be affected by futures markets, dividends and changing conditions.

Brokers may need stronger benchmarks to demonstrate execution quality, while proprietary technology can offer a closer fit for institutional requirements.

Russian-Language Campaigns Missed Audiences in Parts of the CIS

Campaign results across six Commonwealth of Independent States markets suggest that a single Russian-language acquisition strategy may overlook local differences. In an analysis, Stanislav Galandzovskyi found that switching to Uzbek-language creative and adding local payment options Click and Payme reduced the reported cost per acquisition in Uzbekistan from about $650 to around $380.

The markets also differ in purchasing power, regulation and payment access. Kazakhstan and Azerbaijan were described as higher-value opportunities, while Uzbekistan offers scale but lower average deposits. Kyrgyzstan may suit smaller tests.

Tajikistan’s limited disposable income and Turkmenistan’s currency controls, which complicate withdrawals, were cited as barriers. The analysis argued for allocating budgets according to funded-trader acquisition costs before assessing longer-term customer value.

The retail trading industry saw developments across proprietary trading, listed derivatives and broker performance this week. FTMO’s founders discussed the firm’s futures launch, its acquisition of OANDA and its ambitions to build a larger trading group. Meanwhile, Plus500 raised its full-year outlook, and NinjaTrader extended its futures platform into the UK.

London's trading industry is coming home!

Quarterly results also highlighted contrasting trends among brokers. CFI reported record trading volumes, while XTB’s profit rose sharply despite lower client trading activity. XTB’s client assets also showed a growing preference for stocks and exchange-traded funds, even as contracts for difference continued to generate most of its trading income.

Elsewhere, institutional trading technology and customer acquisition strategies remained in focus, with analysis examining execution infrastructure and the challenges of reaching forex traders across markets in the Commonwealth of Independent States.

FTMO’s Futures Launch Follows a Decade of Growth and the OANDA Deal

FTMO co-founders Otakar Šuffner and Marek Vašíček discussed the firm’s move into futures trading, its acquisition of OANDA and the challenges facing proprietary trading firms. Founded in 2015, FTMO initially focused on CFDs because it lacked the capital and experience to enter futures.

The company launched its futures offering recently, responding to customer demand and a market where futures evaluations can cost less than comparable CFD and forex challenges. The founders said combining FTMO’s business with OANDA’s established reputation could help distinguish the group from newer firms.

FTMO Futures is officially LIVE. 🏆 The gold standard of prop trading, now powered for the exchange via Tradovate, NinjaTrader, and TradingView. No compromises. Just raw execution and total transparency. Explore FTMO Futures today 🙌🏻 https://t.co/g8HztyeUu4 https://t.co/WMDSy8DcRX

— FTMO.com (@FTMO_com) August 31, 2026

They also discussed regulatory uncertainty, abusive trading groups targeting evaluation systems and the possibility of a future initial public offering.

Plus500 Raises Its 2026 Outlook After Revenue Growth

Plus500 expects full-year 2026 revenue and EBITDA to exceed market expectations, reversing its guidance from July, when it forecast results in line with consensus. Third-quarter revenue rose 11% year on year to $203.2 million, while EBITDA increased 7% to $88.4 million.

Revenue for the first nine months reached $666.1 million, up 11%. New customers rose 27% to 28,747 in the quarter, active customers increased 4% to 119,528 and average revenue per user reached $1,700. Customer deposits hit a quarterly record of $1.9 billion. The company also reported growth in customer trading income, while interest income fell amid lower global interest rates.

NinjaTrader Brings Its Retail Futures Platform to the UK

NinjaTrader has launched its retail futures trading platform in the UK, extending a European rollout that already covers Germany, France, Italy, Spain and the Netherlands. UK customers can access futures on US equity indices, energy, metals and foreign exchange through CME and Eurex markets.

The platform includes proprietary charting tools, algorithmic trading capabilities and native TradingView integration. NinjaTrader said UK traders had sought direct market access, transparent pricing and execution , and a platform designed specifically for futures.

The launch comes as European brokers explore listed products amid regulatory pressure on CFDs, more experienced retail traders and competition from US firms specialising in futures and options.

CFI Financial Group reported third-quarter notional trading volume of $3.45 trillion, a record for the Dubai-based broker and an increase of about 123% year on year. The figure was 14% higher than in the second quarter. Trading volume for the first nine months reached $8.8 trillion, roughly double the same period last year and already above CFI’s full-year 2025 total of $6.4 trillion.

The company has reported higher volumes in each quarter of 2026, rising from $2.3 trillion in the first quarter to $3.03 trillion in the second. The growth came as the broader broker market tracked by Finance Magnates Intelligence contracted in the second quarter.

content:
2026-10-30T21:24:04.480+02:00

Friday, 30/10/2026 | 19:24 GMT by Tareq Sikder

  • Topstep, Apex, Tradeify and Goat Funded Cut Ties with the popular comparison platform after a trader alleged it triggered “affiliate links through internal website clicks”.
  • Prop Firm Match: "This should not have happened. We take full responsibility for it".

Prop Firm Match, a prop trading firm comparison platform, has been accused on social media of allegedly triggering affiliate links when visitors click internal features, including firm profiles and promotional code buttons. Several firms announced cutting ties with the platform following the publication. In a recent post, Prop Firm Match said: "This should not have happened. We take full responsibility for it".

An industry insider said that the firms - including Topstep, Apex, Tradeify and Goat Funded - were alarmed after reading the reader's post because Prop Firm Match earns commission on challenges sold through its affiliate link, so firing that link on clicks that weren’t affiliate clicks could get it credited with sales it didn’t send, or with sales another affiliate sent.

London's trading industry is coming home!

Trader Kane (@traderkane) raised the allegations in a video posted on X on Thursday. He said the redirects occurred when visitors clicked these features rather than advertised external links. The original browser tab was reportedly redirected through an affiliate link to the relevant prop firm's website, while the intended page opened in a new tab.

Are we still on the "deceitful marketing algo"? Hey @PropFirmMatch, did you knowingly push an update that stuffs cookies when people aren’t clicking links advertised in the code as external websites? Here’s what happens: someone clicks the profile page or copy code link that links to the internal page and your javascript handler redirects the original tab through an affiliate link to the firm’s website and opens the intended link a new tab... sounds pretty knowing to me. You even ban your affiliates from forcing cookies.. but you can, huh? Some pretty big affiliates have gone to prison for cookie stuffing. I used @MattLeech's MFFU as an example in this video but this happens on most firms listed on their website (I didn't check them all). Firms are banning traders for deceitful marketing, if this isn't deceitful what is?

— kane🧪 (@traderkane) October 29, 2026

Apex, Tradeify and Topstep Cut Ties

Apex Trader Funding announced on X on Friday (30 October) that it had terminated its affiliate relationship with Prop Firm Match and disabled all associated tracking codes.

🚨BREAKING: PROP FIRM MATCH OFFICIALLY DELISTED! 💀 This is getting BIGGER than anyone expected. Major firms are now cutting ties with @PropFirmMatch, including: • FundingPips • GoatFunded Trader • GFFutures • Lucid Trading • Take Profit Trader • Blue Guardian • Alpha Capital • Apex Trader Funding Following serious cookie-stuffing allegations and concerns over referral tracking practices, firms are taking action. Major firms has already terminated its affiliate partnership and disabled all associated tracking codes. THE INDUSTRY IS TAKING A STAND. Yesterday it was allegations. Today, major firms are walking away. This could be one of the biggest shake-ups the prop firm industry has seen. 👀

— Trusted Prop Hub (@TrustedPropHub) October 30, 2026

Apex said the decision followed a review of referral tracking practices and compliance with its Affiliate Marketing Agreement. It did not specify which practices prompted the termination or whether it found a breach of the agreement.

Apex Trader Funding has terminated its affiliate relationship with Prop Firm Match, effective immediately. All associated affiliate tracking codes have been disabled. This decision follows a review of referral tracking practices and compliance with our Affiliate Marketing Agreement. We hold all affiliates to clear standards regarding transparency, accurate referral attribution, and responsible marketing practices. Protecting the integrity of our Affiliate Program and ensuring fair, transparent referral practices remain priorities for Apex Trader Funding.

— ApexTraderFunding (@ApexTradeFund) October 30, 2026

Tradeify also announced on X that it had ended its relationship with Prop Firm Match after finding, as claimed, that the platform had breached its affiliate terms. The decision also means Prop Firm Match will no longer sponsor the Premier Trading League (PTL).

We’ve decided to part ways with @PropFirmMatch. After looking closely at how referrals to our site were being generated, we found they broke our affiliate terms, so we’re stepping away. This also means @PropFirmMatch will no longer sponsor the Premier Trading League @JoinPTL. It’s a shame the relationship had to end this way. The affiliate space needs leaders to keep it fair for traders. We’ll be looking closely at all of our affiliates going forward.

— Tradeify (@Tradeify) October 30, 2026

Topstep has also said it is ending its relationship with Prop Firm Match and so did Goat Funded Trader.

Effective immediately, Goat Funded Trader have terminated its affiliate partnership with Prop Firm Match. All associated tracking codes are disabled. This follows a review of referral tracking practices. We do not compromise on transparency, accurate attribution, or responsible marketing. The integrity of our program comes first. Always.

— Goat Funded Trader (@GoatFunded) October 30, 2026

Affiliate Rules Prohibit Forced Tracking

Prop Firm Match's affiliate terms prohibit hidden iframe redirects, forced cookies and other methods of artificially generating referrals. Its website discloses that it earns commissions from prop firm challenge purchases made through its affiliate links and promotional codes.

fyi - we are dropping Prop firm Match.. we didn't have a code and we paid them $10k a month to list us (best rank we got was 6th place.. i heard 1st cost $100k/m) ... now we save $10k a month... time to have a @TopstepTV Fire Drill (thats where we give away stuff on tv) .. we got an extra $10,000 a month in our budget!! Let go!

— mp (@MichaelPatak) October 30, 2026

The alleged redirects have raised questions about how affiliate referrals are attributed and whether the practice complies with the platform's own rules.

Effective immediately @PropFirmMatch affiliate partnership is terminated. All their commissions for the month are forfeited, and financial claims are going to be pursued. We have caught the cookies practices in August, took actions on it and Our rank dropped from Nr. 1 best seller to Nr.10. Plus being told that traders picking us over other firms costs them money, which I understand since their commission is same as any other affiliate. Since the beginning we have supported them, tech, expertise and features, yet that business grew into something I personally don’t believe in. Adios 👊🏽

— Khaled (@Khldfx) October 30, 2026

Prop Firm Match published this morning a post about the situation. "Until yesterday, when someone clicked on a firm or a code on our site, a new tab would open the firm’s site through our affiliate link", the company said. "This should not have happened. We take full responsibility for it. We have reached out to each of our partners to review this together and reconcile any inaccuracies. We respect any decisions firms have made based on this".

title: Coinbase (COIN) Misses Revenue Estimates as Users Fall, Armstrong Sets Up New Share Sales
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

Coinbase (COIN) Misses Revenue Estimates as Users Fall, Armstrong Sets Up New Share Sales
Coinbase missed revenue expectations as users declined, despite growth in recurring revenue, while executive share-sale plans and a massive Binance security breach added pressure to crypto mar...
content:
Coinbase had a mixed third quarter. Revenue came in at $1.20 billion, below the $1.233 billion analysts expected, according to company filings. Subscription and services revenue did better, reaching $570 million. The company is still heavily tied to trading activity, but its recurring income is growing.

Monthly Transacting Users fell to 7.4 million, down from 9.3 million a year earlier. During its earnings call, Coinbase blamed overall market conditions. Its share of crypto trading volume did rise to 10.7%, the fourth straight quarter of gains, which suggests it is winning business even as the broader market quiets. 

Adjusted EBITDA was $332.9 million, extending a run of 15 straight profitable quarters on that measure. The prediction markets business passed $200 million in annualized revenue, and Coinbase One hit a record number of subscribers.

Coinbase CEO preps share sales

Separately, filings reported on October 30 show CEO Brian Armstrong has set up a plan to sell up to 8.17 million Class A shares. He adopted the plan in August under SEC Rule 10b5-1, which lets executives schedule sales ahead of time. Sales could run from November 16 through October 2027, subject to stock price conditions. Co-founder Fred Ehrsam and President Emilie Choi have similar plans, bringing the total to about 13.6 million shares.

This is not new territory for Armstrong. In the past, VanEck analyst Matthew Sigel tracked about $545.7 million in sales over nine months, starting in April 2025. Armstrong has said these sales are part of his risk management, not a signal about the company.

Coinbase stock slumps nearly 15% 

Coinbase shares (COIN) fell about 15% today, but not necessarily due to this earnings report. 

Binance disclosed a security breach on October 29 that it estimates at $6.3 billion, making it the largest crypto theft on record. Around $3 billion in assets has been frozen so far, with industry partners assisting in the freezes. 

The hackers are allegedly linked to North Korea, though Binance has not attributed the attack to any group. The exchange says it has found no evidence of a leaked wallet private key.

Binance says it has $6.34 billion in reserves available to cover losses. Deposits were unaffected, and the company expects to resume withdrawals within 48 hours. Figures remain preliminary, and estimates vary slightly across outlets.

The market reacted quickly. Bitcoin fell roughly 4.5% to below $77,000. Shares of Strategy (MSTR) fell nearly 10% on the day. Strive (ASST) shares fell over 12% at times. Coinbase’s stock is down over 55% on the year.

Micah Zimmerman

Micah first discovered Bitcoin in 2018 but remained a skeptic on the sidelines for too long. Since 2021, he has covered crypto and business and now works as a news reporter for Bitcoin Magazine, based in North Carolina.

title: Binance Hack: CZ Fires Back at Elon Musk, Cites $1B SpaceX Stake as Coinbase Offers Security Support
summary: Binance founder Changpeng Zhao has urged Elon Musk to stop mocking the exchange after its $6.3 billion security incident, while Coinbase offered assistance.
content:
Skip to content

Binance founder Changpeng Zhao has urged Elon Musk to stop mocking the exchange after its $6.3 billion security incident, while Coinbase offered assistance.

The dispute unfolded as Binance worked to contain the October 29 attack, freeze affected assets, and reassure customers that their funds would remain protected. Zhao, widely known as CZ, referred to Binance’s investment in SpaceX while defending the exchange’s financial position. Meanwhile, Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong said his team was helping block transactions involving compromised wallets and had contacted Binance directly.

Summary

  • Binance founder CZ asked Elon Musk to stop making jokes about the exchange’s $6.3 billion security breach, calling the timing inappropriate.
  • Zhao cited Binance’s SpaceX shares, valued at more than $1 billion, following its $500 million investment in Elon Musk’s Twitter takeover.
  • Binance co-CEO Yi He said the company’s annual revenue was sufficient to cover the losses without selling its SpaceX holdings.
  • Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong offered assistance by blocking transfers to compromised wallets and contacting Binance.
  • Binance reported that approximately $3 billion in affected assets had been frozen and committed to covering all losses through its SAFU fund and company resources.

CZ asks Elon Musk to stop mocking Binance

The disagreement started after Musk reacted to Zhao’s cybersecurity warning and subsequent reports of the attack on Binance.

On October 28, Zhao published a warning on X, advising users against opening suspicious email links or downloading attachments, even when messages appeared to come from trusted contacts. Musk responded with fire and laughing emojis.

CZ urges Elon Musk to stop mocking Binance’s record $6.3 billion hack, citing the crisis’s seriousness while expressing respect for him. Source: X

Following reports of the Binance incident, Musk commented, “Everyday is Zeroday,” referring to zero-day vulnerabilities. These are previously unknown security weaknesses that attackers can exploit before developers have an opportunity to address them.

The exchange continued as details of the security breach emerged. When Zhao’s earlier warning resurfaced, he said he wished more people had followed the advice. He also acknowledged that the attack appeared more complex, adding that compromised devices or algorithms frequently play a role in security incidents.

Musk’s “Everyday is Zeroday” remark underscores the constant threat of zero-day exploits, particularly for high-value crypto platforms. Source: Elon Musk via X

Zhao eventually addressed Musk directly, asking him to stop making jokes while Binance dealt with the financial and operational consequences.

“Elon, have a lot of respect for you, but bad time to troll. Please stop,” Zhao wrote on X.

He also reminded Musk of Binance’s financial connection to his businesses, pointing to the exchange’s investment in the Twitter acquisition and asking for support during the incident.

Binance’s SpaceX holdings enter the dispute

Zhao’s response brought Binance’s investment in SpaceX into the public discussion. He said the exchange’s stake originated from its $500 million contribution toward Musk’s acquisition of Twitter in 2022.

“Our SPCX shares (from our $500m investment in your Twitter takeover) are worth more than a billion,” Zhao wrote.

The statement attracted questions from X users about how an investment in SpaceX related to Binance’s security problems. Zhao subsequently explained that he was referring to the company’s financial resources when assessing its ability to cover the incident’s impact.

His preliminary calculation considered the estimated $6.3 billion impact, approximately $3 billion in frozen assets, and more than $1 billion available through Binance’s Secure Asset Fund for Users (SAFU).

Based on those figures, Zhao estimated a potential funding gap of around $2 billion. He described the remaining amount as manageable, although financially painful.

However, the calculation was not a final assessment of Binance’s net losses or the amount of assets that could ultimately be recovered. Zhao also did not announce any plans to sell the company’s SpaceX holdings.

The distinction is important because frozen assets, insurance-style reserves, and company investments represent different sources of financial support. Their availability and eventual use depend on recovery progress and the exchange’s financial decisions.

Yi He says Binance revenue can cover losses

Binance co-CEO Yi He responded to Zhao’s comments, saying the exchange had sufficient annual revenue to absorb the losses without selling its SpaceX investment.

“Reporting to the major shareholder: Our company’s revenue for the year is sufficient to cover the losses, so we do not yet need to sell the SpaceX shares you are bullish on,” she wrote.

Binance’s $500M Twitter takeover investment reportedly grew its SpaceX stake to over $1B amid the security breach dispute. Source: Yi He via X

Zhao subsequently clarified that he had not suggested selling the holdings. Instead, he said he mentioned their value to demonstrate Binance’s available financial resources and potentially reassure Musk about the company’s ability to manage the incident.

The exchange has separately committed to covering all losses using its SAFU reserve and company funds. In an October 30 update, the exchange said it had reserved approximately $6.34 billion in company funds to address the incident.

The exchange also disclosed that it already held around $5 billion in the affected cryptocurrencies and was purchasing the remaining approximately $1.34 billion through market transactions and over-the-counter channels. The objective is to restore affected assets in their original tokens rather than simply compensate users with an equivalent dollar amount.

This reserve is separate from the approximately $3 billion in affected assets frozen with assistance from blockchain partners. The exchange said it would continue working with law enforcement, token issuers, blockchain intelligence firms, and other industry participants to trace and recover additional funds.

The exchange also plans to publish updated Proof of Reserves information after the recovery and remediation process is complete.

Binance’s preliminary investigation initially pointed to a compromised DevOps engineer’s laptop, which allegedly allowed an attacker to access a service container and initiate unauthorized withdrawal transactions. The exchange reported no evidence that wallet private keys had been exposed.

Subsequent reporting indicated that investigators were examining additional points of breach. Blockchain intelligence firm TRM Labs estimated that approximately $6.36 billion had moved from Binance wallets across multiple blockchains, with most of the transfers occurring within roughly 20 minutes.

TRM Labs and Chainalysis separately attributed the attack to North Korea-linked hacking group TraderTraitor. However, Binance has not publicly confirmed the identity of the attackers and said it was cooperating with law enforcement to establish who was responsible.

Musk’s Binance hack comments draw mixed reactions

Musk’s remarks attracted reactions from cryptocurrency executives, industry participants, and traders as Binance worked to contain the incident.

Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong offered direct assistance, saying the exchange was helping prevent transfers to wallets associated with the attack. He also confirmed that Coinbase had contacted Binance to offer support.

Brian Armstrong announces Coinbase’s proactive response to the record $6.3B Binance hack. Source: Brian Armstrong via X

“Our team is doing everything we can to support in the current situation, including blocking sends to compromised wallets,” Armstrong wrote.

He added, “Moments like this call for the industry to work together.”

The response highlighted the role of cooperation between cryptocurrency exchanges and blockchain service providers during security incidents. Tether and Circle also helped freeze assets linked to the attack, contributing to the comapny’s reported recovery efforts.

Meanwhile, the breach placed additional pressure on cryptocurrency markets. Bitcoin and other digital assets faced selling pressure following the incident, with Bitcoin briefly approaching six-week lows near $76,000 as concerns about exchange security affected market sentiment.

Coinbase reaffirmed its security measures, monitored Binance’s crisis, and offered support, including blocking transfers to compromised wallets. Source: Coinbase via X

Binance’s operational restrictions also became an important concern for customers. The exchange initially suspended deposits and withdrawals while reviewing its security systems and affected withdrawal addresses. In a subsequent service update, the exchange confirmed that deposits were operating normally, while withdrawals remained paused during a security revamp. It expected withdrawal services to resume within 48 hours of the October 30 update.

The exchange reiterated that user funds would remain protected and pledged to publish a detailed technical report once its investigation was complete.

The public disagreement between Zhao and Musk has added another dimension to Binance’s recovery efforts. While Zhao has pointed to the exchange’s financial resources and SpaceX investment, Yi He has said annual revenue can cover the shortfall without selling those holdings. Coinbase’s offer of assistance has also demonstrated how competing exchanges can coordinate when a security incident affects the wider cryptocurrency industry.

2026-10-30T20:09:05.583+02:00

Friday, 30/10/2026 | 18:09 GMT by Tareq Sikder

  • Tether froze nearly $1.57 billion in USDT linked to the Binance hack, according to its CEO.
  • TRM Labs attributed the Binance hack to “North Korean group TraderTraitor with high confidence”.

The US Secret Service is working with stablecoin issuer Circle to recover funds stolen in the $6.3 billion security breach at Binance. The effort also involves the FBI and cryptocurrency industry firms.

London's trading industry is coming home!

Crypto Briefing reported that the Secret Service confirmed its cooperation with Circle on October 30, a day after the breach. Reuters separately reported, citing a person familiar with the matter, that Binance is working with both the FBI and the Secret Service.

FBI Coordinates Binance Hack Investigation

The FBI said it was aware of the incident and was working with public- and private-sector partners to assess its impact and coordinate investigative steps.

Circle has frozen more than $800 million in USDC linked to the breach, according to its CEO, Jeremy Allaire, who said the action was taken in coordination with law enforcement. Tether has also frozen nearly $1.57 billion in related USDT, according to CEO Paolo Ardoino.

JUST IN: 🇺🇸 US Secret Service is working with Circle to identify, freeze, and recover funds stolen from Binance. https://t.co/v8kGqYRh5r

— Watcher.Guru (@WatcherGuru) October 30, 2026

The freezes by the two stablecoin issuers total more than $2.37 billion. Binance has put the total value of assets frozen by industry partners at around $3 billion, including actions by other firms.

Circle and Tether can freeze their stablecoins at specific blockchain addresses, allowing them to restrict transfers linked to the incident. However, frozen assets have not necessarily been recovered or returned to affected users.

TRM, A U.S.-based blockchain intelligence firm, attributed the attack to TraderTraitor, which it described as North Korea’s elite hacking unit. “We make this judgment with high confidence,” the firm said in a post on its website Thursday. https://t.co/jQtTVPVJGQ

— NBC 6 South Florida (@nbc6) October 30, 2026

TRM Attributes Binance Attack to “North Korea”

Separately, blockchain intelligence firm TRM Labs attributed the attack to TraderTraitor, a North Korean hacking group, with “high confidence”. TRM said its assessment was based on on-chain and off-chain intelligence. The firm is tracking the funds and alerting industry partners through its Beacon Network.

CFTC Cites Binance Hack in Registration Push

Separately, CFTC Chairman Michael Selig cited the Binance breach as support for a proposed voluntary registration framework for offshore cryptocurrency exchanges serving US retail traders. Under the plan, participating platforms would be required to meet US cybersecurity and customer protection standards. Selig said broader federal registration would require congressional action. The CFTC is targeting December 14, 2026, for the proposed rulemaking.
